rows.claim: The one project compiler parses tested modules once, resolves module/import aliases, retains parsed/proven facts through typed CFG and value SSA, and returns deterministic project facts.

rows.claim: Dense explicit value IDs, typed instructions, edge arguments, join block parameters, branch/jump/return terminators, local scalar values, canonical imported scalar calls, finite-match switches, scalar-match switches, payload extraction, enum construction, sequence repetition, nested nominal payloads, record field projection, heterogeneous-type match environments, arm result joins, nested matches, and compiler-operation instructions are verified against Stage-0 body/SSA facts.

rows.claim: The valid two-module merge passes; nine targeted malformed identity, definition/use, type, argument, target, and return mutations are rejected. The finite/enum slice adds ten further corruption rejections (enum identity, variant, arity, payload type, match variant, join target, edge value, payload declared type, repeat count, repeat operand type). The scalar-match slice adds four further corruption rejections (duplicate pattern, default target, edge value, missing default). The nested-match slice adds eight further corruption rejections. The projection slice adds six further corruption rejections (field index, identity invalid, identity mismatch, provenance, result type, forged base). The compiler-operation slice adds seven further corruption rejections (slot, identity invalid, identity mismatch, arity, result type, input type, provenance) plus an unauthorized twin matching Stage-0 at the same span.
limits: Verifier coverage is bounded to the emitted instruction/terminator slice.

rows.claim: Nine native plans select the affected source, parser, kernel, declaration, CFG, project, and SSA obligations. Every selected obligation has exact current identity-bound PASS evidence; reference-only Stage-0 pressure probes are excluded from native-source plans.
limits: Planning total was 95.428 seconds at pin 843c5bc. Plans are direct_dependents selections and do not execute tests or establish repository-canonical stop sufficiency. No fresh plans cover the finite/enum slice.
